text: Pakhtakor's official website lists the Tashkent city administration in its partners section (a logo linking to tashkent.uz); tashkent.uz identifies itself with the words 'Тошкент шаҳар ҳокимияти расмий сайти' (official website of the Tashkent city administration), Uzbekistan's state administration for the capital.
short: Pakhtakor lists the Tashkent city administration (hokimiyat) as a partner.

source.name: «ПАХТАКОР» Футбол клуби — official website, homepage ('Бизнинг ҳамкорлар' partners section; Wayback snapshot 2026-08-31)
source.note: The partners grid is logo-only; the city-administration logo image (partners/hokim1.png) links to https://tashkent.uz. Same grid content verified on the live homepage https://www.pakhtakor.uz/ on 2026-09-30.

additionalSources.name: Toshkent shahar hokimiyati rasmiy sayti (tashkent.uz)
additionalSources.note: The portal's footer/title identify it as the official website of the Tashkent city administration, with the hokimiyat's address and phone.
